items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Import task - Public API support
items.description:
Public APIs for the Import tasks capability enable customers and partners to programmatically import tasks from one project into another. Organizations can call these APIs from custom applications, integrations, or automated workflows instead of requiring a user to initiate each import manually.
The APIs support repeatable project-creation and planning scenarios, such as populating new projects with tasks from templates or previously completed projects. Customers can incorporate task imports int

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Choose the data sources AI-powered Data Enrichment uses, including CRM notes
items.description: AI-powered Data Enrichment now lets admins choose which data sources the agent uses to enrich records. Outlook emails, Teams meetings, and the new CRM notes source each have their own control toggle, and the agent keeps running as long as at least one source is toggled on. Admins no longer need to connect every permission before they create the agent. With CRM notes, the agent extracts insights from manual notes added to supported records and uses them to enrich those records, with no tenant adm

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Pro Management portal Analytics & Reports Design Refresh
items.description: We are refreshing the way we organize the Analytics & Reports area in the Pro Management portal to make it more user-friendly.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Improved Matrix visual performance for large table
items.description: Business Performance Planning introduce Virtualization to optimizes how the Matrix visual renders large planning datasets. Rather than loading and displaying the entire dataset at once, the visual progressively renders the rows and columns needed as users scroll, expand, collapse, and navigate through the Matrix. This reduces the amount of data processed by the browser at any one time and helps maintain visual responsiveness at scale.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Events now support up to 20,000 registrations, making it easier to reach and engage larger audiences at scale
items.description: Connect with more attendees than ever before with Teams Events, now supporting up to 20,000 registrations for organizers with valid Attendee packs.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Procurement Agent - Customize the Procurement Agent supplier follow-up criteria
items.description: Organizations often use business-specific data and criteria to determine when suppliers require follow-up on purchase orders. The Procurement Agent will enable buyers to extend supplier follow-up criteria using related standard, extended, and custom table data. Buyers can add table joins and use fields from those tables as filter conditions, providing greater flexibility to determine which purchase order lines qualify for supplier follow-up based on their organization’s processes and data.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Scheduling with Copilot
items.description: Users can now schedule appointments and meetings directly from chat. Simply ask Copilot to create an appointment or schedule a meeting with colleagues, and it will find available times, book rooms, draft agendas, and send invites—all within the chat experience.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Discover and use shared plugins in Copilot Studio
items.description: Copilot Studio now connects to Microsoft's shared plugin registry, making it easier for makers to discover and use plugins, connectors, and other available capabilities. This integration provides a more consistent way to extend agents with capabilities across Microsoft's AI ecosystem.

items.title: Outlook: Improved SharePoint file experience in file picker in Outlook mobile apps
items.description: Users can more easily work with SharePoint files in Outlook by saving email attachments directly to SharePoint and searching across SharePoint sites for files from the file picker.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars on Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: When a Teams Rooms on Android device acts as an organizer, co-organizer, or presenter in a structured meeting or webinar, you have access to the private chat for event management known as the Event Group. You can also switch to a separate chat with attendees, enabling smooth event experiences for all. Available in Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: External presenter support for event group chat
items.description: Event group chat, the private chat for organizers, co-organizers, and presenters in an event or structured meeting, will support external presenters.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Invite attendees to register
items.description: For an event that needs registration, send email invites to the selected people and groups who will be invited to register to the event

items.title: Microsoft Teams: QR code protection in Teams messaging
items.description: Microsoft Teams will provide additional protection for QR codes shared by external users in messages. Images containing QR codes from external senders will be obscured by default and require users to reveal them before viewing or scanning. This helps reduce the risk of phishing and fraud by encouraging more deliberate interaction with QR code content.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Admins can control profanity filtering in meeting transcripts
items.description: Teams administrators will be able to use a meeting policy to control whether profane words are masked in live transcription and saved meeting transcripts. Filtering remains on by default. When an organizer is assigned a policy that turns filtering off, profane words can appear without masking in both the live and saved transcript, while live captions continue to follow each participant's existing profanity setting.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Conversational configuration of connectors in Copilot Studio
items.description: Configure the connectors your agent needs, with a simple in-chat sign-in instead of a full settings experience.

items.title: Universal Print: Universal Print Portal
items.description: You can release your secure print jobs by scanning a QR code at any printer and access your print workflows from a browser on any device, all signed in with your Microsoft 365 account.

items.title: SharePoint: AI overview for SharePoint News posts in the SharePoint app for Teams
items.description: Users will be able access an AI generated audio summary of SharePoint News posts in the SharePoint app for Teams (Viva Connections).

items.title: SharePoint: Governance Reviews Dashboard for Site Owners
items.description:
Site owners have a critical role to play in ensuring accuracy of site information, including the site's necessity, its owners, members, permissions, and sharing settings. We’re introducing the Governance Reviews Dashboard in Private Preview, a centralized view where site owners can see all pending site governance reviews (inactivity, ownership, attestation) across the sites they own.
The dashboard shows required actions, due timelines, and site enforcement status and allows site owners to take a

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Simplifying Content in the Input Box
items.description: When users insert content in a prompt using 'Add Work Content' under the Plus menu, the content will only appear as a pill in the Input Box UI and will not be repeated as part of the user's prompt. This helps to simplify the Input Box and reserve it for prompt creation. Updated April 22, 2026: We are moving this item back to In Development and will be relaunching after further updates. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Enterprise New Tab Page experience
items.description: A modern experience for the New Tab Page (NTP) on Microsoft Edge for Business.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Viva Engage - Community Agent
items.description: Community Agent helps members get answers to questions in Viva Engage communities using community knowledge and connected sources. Community admins can choose to require human review before answers are posted or allow automatic posting.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention - Optical character recognition (OCR) support for endpoint
items.description: Optical character recognition (OCR) support will detect sensitive content in images and subsequently apply data loss prevention (DLP) policies to prevent exfiltration of that sensitive data on your Windows endpoint devices. This release supports key file types like JPG, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, BMP and PDF (image only PDF).

items.title: Outlook: Upcoming visual improvements and a more consistent Outlook experience
items.description: The first updates will focus on visual details, such as icons, spacing and alignment. Users of classic Outlook for Windows will begin seeing refinements to familiar mail and calendar surfaces. The initial visual updates are intended to improve clarity and consistency without changing how users perform their tasks.

items.title: SharePoint: AI input widget and content preview in Copilot
items.description: With this new capability, users of Copilot in SharePoint will be able to view saved and unsaved preview content side by side with chat.  Users will also be able to interact with created HTML forms and confirm responses to send to chat.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Review financial dimensions when approving expenses on mobile
items.description: Approvers need access to the financial information behind an expense to make accurate approval decisions without leaving the approval experience. Dynamics 365 expense management mobile app will surface relevant financial dimensions directly within expense report approvals in the mobile app. Approvers can review financial coding in context before making a decision, helping reduce unnecessary navigation and keep expense approvals moving.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Track mileage expenses using kilometers
items.description: Organizations operating across different regions need to record mileage expenses using the units of measure appropriate for their employees and local requirements. Dynamics 365 Project Operations will support kilometers (km) as a configurable unit of measure for mileage expenses, in addition to miles. Organizations can configure the appropriate mileage unit for their business, helping employees record mileage expenses accurately using the measurement standard relevant to their regional requireme

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Event Chat now available for Events optimized for a large audience in GCC
items.description: All users in Events larger than 1,000 users or in any Event optimized for a large audience can now chat with one another in a public event chat in GCC.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Streaming switchboard for Network Device Interface (NDI) Sources
items.description: For Teams meetings and events, a new streaming switchboard will soon be available to easily manage and send NDI sources out to production software.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in OneNote can create, edit, and refine content
items.description: Copilot in OneNote can generate new content and directly edit when in edit mode. In this mode you can create, rename, and delete pages, sections, or notebooks as well as add or edit content in pages. Copilot can bring content from across WorkIQ as well as complete actions across other workflows such as creating Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files.

items.title: Planner: Refreshed experience and new capabilities
items.description: Microsoft Planner will be updated with a cleaner, more modern interface, improved navigation, responsive layouts, and a more consistent experience across Planner in Teams and Planner for the web.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Cancel packing slips for stocked item requirements
items.description: This feature supports controlled returns and packing slip cancellations for stocked item requirements originating in Finance and Supply Chain Management. You can open the Packing slip journal from the Item requirements page and cancel packing slips for eligible independent item requirements. Packing slip posting performs the physical inventory update while deferring the financial update, allowing cancellation before invoicing or finalization. items.title: Microsoft Viva: Expanded agent coverage in Agent Dashboard
items.description: Customers can now view reporting for agents from third-party platforms in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics). This expanded coverage provides a more comprehensive view of agent activity across their organization.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Audio Overview updates in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: We're rolling out new capabilities for Copilot Notebook audio overview that make it easier to navigate longer content with topic-based episodes, new audio formats such as Critique and Debate, support enterprise information protection with sensitivity labels, and expand audio overview context to more content types.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Tenant-level dashboard for Interpreter
items.description: We have decided not to move forward with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience. Admins now have a dedicated dashboard in the Teams Admin Center to view Interpreter usage across their organization. Track adoption and usage trends in one place to better understand how Interpreter is being used.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM – New Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management Experience
items.description: At Ignite, Microsoft is introducing a major evolution of Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) to help organizations strengthen data security and confidently embrace AI. The new DSPM experience unifies visibility and control across traditional data and AI-driven environments, delivering outcome-based guided workflows that turn insights into actionable steps—so teams can prioritize risks and remediate faster. items.title: Microsoft Teams: Delete meeting generated content in recap
items.description: Meeting organizers can now easily delete meeting generated content including recording, transcript, AI summary, and notes through the new delete button in recap page. Shared files in the meeting won't be deleted.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Centralized notification settings for channels
items.description: Centralized notification settings streamline channel notification setup and management. Available in Teams settings, users have a single place to review and adjust notifications for all visible channels, instead of managing each individually.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference an email with Work IQ when using Edit with Copilot in PowerPoint to create a presentation
items.description: You can now reference an email with Work IQ when using Edit with Copilot in PowerPoint to create a presentation.

items.title: Outlook: Agents for Microsoft 365 Copilot available in Copilot Chat in Outlook for Mac
items.description: We will be adding declarative agents support in Copilot Chat in Outlook. This roadmap item tracks availability in Outlook for Mac.
